name: codex-sdk
description: Provider-specific SDK for interacting with Codex App Server.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target node && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.fmt: oxfmt src tests scripts README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json CHANGELOG.md
scripts.fmt:check: oxfmt --check src tests scripts README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json CHANGELOG.md
